text:
anya: quick proposal: 'config-pulse' = short live-preview + telemetry gate before any gradual rollout. want feedback on API + playbook.

ben: short version?

anya: operator triggers a pulse (10-60s window) that routes a tiny sampled percent (0.2%-0.5%) of real traffic through the new config path. we collect delta metrics and a lightweight eval set. UI shows green/yellow/red and suggests next step.

caroline: 0.2% sounds safe but how do we isolate billing/quota?

diego: we should mark pulse traffic as "preview:true" at ingress so downstream services and billing can ignore it. router will tag headers and metrics.

anya: API sketch: POST /api/config/pulse { config_id, sample_pct, duration_secs, dedupe_key?, metrics: [...] } -> returns pulse_id. GET /api/config/pulse/{id}/summary -> safety_score + diffs + raw_links.

ben: example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/api/config/pulse \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"config_id":"cfg:x","sample_pct":0.3,"duration_secs":30,"metrics":["latency_p95","error_rate","token_cost"]}'
```

ops-bot: staging branch for pulse feature live: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/pulse/78 :rocket:

caroline: what about cache semantics? KV prefix/cache could make diffs meaningless if cached responses served. we need to either flush or pin cache keys for pulse requests.

diego: agree. simplest: add header X-Preview-TTL=0 to bypass short-term caches for pulse. heavier option: a pinned shadow cache shard but that's more infra work.

anya: telemetry gating: pulse collects 1m aggregations and compares to baseline window of 15m pre-pulse. compute relative deltas and run small-sample A/B for text-quality hooks.

ben: scoring algorithm: safety_score = max(0, 1 - weighted_sum([max(err_delta,0)*w1, max(lat_delta,0)*w2, quality_regressions*w3])). threshold 0.92 -> ok to create gradual rollout.

caroline: audit fields: pulse_id, operator, config_patch_hash, dedupe_key, start_ts, end_ts. retention: summaries 90d, raw traces 7d.

diego: ops-safety: enforce budget cap per org and global concurrent pulses. pulse should not consume autoscaling credits or count against quota; implement quota-exempt flag.

anya: UX: modal on config page: run pulse (0.1-0.5%) -> show safety_score, top-3 metrics, sparkline, "apply 5% rollout" and "abort". include ledger link to audit.

ben: add dedupe_key for idempotency.

caroline: add e2e against canary infra asserting summary format and unit tests for score calc.

diego: router header + cache bypass prototype; 2d work, will PR.

ops-bot: CI: pulse-prototype branch passed integration tests on staging: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/pulse/78/logs

anya: opening RFC with API contract + console mock. tagging @caroline for audit & retention, @diego for router patch, @ben for score calc. sync tomorrow 10:30. thanks.
